observations: Rear view shows the new shaft and two opposed bearing assemblies attached to actual case lands; no visibly floating receiver.
Mechanism view distinguishes separate bearings, shaft, levers and attachment hardware; the old rod nut/pin are included.
Revised Y-plane section exposes the semicircular key, hub, turned shaft and closed bearing end. The first X-plane cut hid the key and is retained as a rejected presentation.
Unchanged-scale SNL23 overlay agrees in overall shaft location and height. The source shaft leans while the model is straight, leaving opposing end offsets.
Case rear contour, bracket depth and foot shape still differ from the drawing. Added lands support the fitted bearings but do not resolve the broader casting discrepancy.
Lower arm direction, unshown depth and integral upper finger remain reconstruction hypotheses. No.C key size is not established by the picture.
